svg.title: DIA-002A · Eighteen times over
svg.desc: An engraved plate of two stacks of coins standing on one ground line, each coin worth ten billion dollars. On the left, a stack of four coins and a thin piece: OpenAI's annualized revenue of 42.6 billion dollars in July 2026. On the right, a column of seventy-five coins: its compute spending target through 2030, about 750 billion dollars. A wooden rule between them is marked off in heights of the short stack. The tall column reaches 17.6 on the rule, roughly eighteen times the short one.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 2 · WHY IT'S MOVING SO FAST
DIA-002A · One year of OpenAI's revenue beside its compute target, in the same coin and on the same ground.
